text:
I checked the `mastermind-ai` task and rewrote its outcome as a ticked checklist, because the original listed no owner asks with proof. `text-check` came back clean.

The new outcome is appended to `session.jsonl`. It ticks two asks, each with proof:
- **Generated files:** `text-check` no longer flags files headed "do not hand-edit", such as `past-work.md`.
- **Stale flags:** after a task has landed, only its newest outcome is checked, so a rewrite clears an old flag.

The task has no `page.js`, and its layout check was skipped because the landing names no site pages. I did not screenshot anything. The rewrite and the `rewrote` line in `flags.jsonl` both went in through the validated append script. No agent owns the task any more, so I applied the rewrite myself.
